title: AI & ML — Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning

value.body: A newer branch built on a computer-science core — programming, data structures, algorithms, databases — with more mathematics (linear algebra, probability, statistics) and courses in machine learning, deep learning, data handling and AI systems. Some colleges call it 'CSE (AI & ML)' or 'AI & Data Science'; the content is similar.

items.label: Course length
items.note: 8 semesters; diploma holders can join year 2 through lateral entry

value.title: How you get in
value.body: You choose the branch at counselling, after the entrance exam. JEE Advanced rank is used for IITs; JEE Main rank for NITs, IIITs and other centrally funded institutes — all allotted through JoSAA. State colleges use state counselling with a state CET (EAMCET, MHT-CET, KCET, WBJEE and others) or, in Tamil Nadu (TNEA), Class 12 marks. Private universities may run their own tests. Class 12 with Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics is required. At many colleges the branch is a CSE specialisation with its own seat pool and cut-off.

value.title: At a glance
items: Most AI/ML jobs ask for strong maths, coding and project work; the branch name alone does not decide hiring.
Many entry-level roles are general software or data roles before specialised ML work.
Research-oriented ML roles often expect an M.Tech, MS or PhD.
Because the branch is new, faculty depth and labs vary a lot between colleges.
